validation_notes: The right side of the chart shows a sharp V-shaped recovery from ~227 low in late July to a strong rally peak near 286 in early August, followed by a small pullback/consolidation of only 3-4 candles (280→272). This is far too brief and lacks the multiple touch points on both a flat support and a descending resistance line needed to qualify as a descending triangle. There's no clear horizontal support being tested repeatedly, nor a series of lower highs converging into it - just one sharp impulsive move up and a minor retracement. This looks more like a breakout/pullback continuation setup than a triangle consolidation. The algorithm likely mistook the tight recent candles for triangle compression, but there aren't enough distinct swing highs/lows to draw two converging trendlines with conviction.
